scope: Finite owned-interface surface inventory for source/evidence consolidation. It indexes prior audits without promoting bounded lexical or runtime tests into whole-interface proof.

surfaces.boundary: Main equalizer/settings tabs, presets, gain/balance, devices, calibration, microphone state, tray, numeric plots and accessibility captions.
surfaces.auditState: indexed; final source/evidence correspondence check pending

surfaces.boundary: Editor/import/save dialogs, generated defaults and taxonomy; imported/published/user names and provenance retain identity.
surfaces.auditState: current source correspondence reviewed; no missing owned string identified

review.fields: Labels use SC_TR; initial editable field values retain imported/user metadata. Generated Custom/My equipment/New profile and measured-response defaults translated at creation; loaded records preserved.
review.diagnostics: 33 literal require validation sites declared; require translates reason before throwing, catches forward translated text. Export/write failures use SC_TR.
review.actions: button and ask callers pass translated labels/titles/body; Save/Discard/Cancel use shared standard-action translator.
review.data: Profile list kind/custom suffix and defined taxonomy translated; brand/family/model/source/conditions/provenance preserved. PK/LS/HS codes, JSON keys/UUIDs and numerical serialized values retained. Response-text frequency header belongs to supported file syntax.
review.plot: Numeric axes and filter values use QLocale; translated captions plus preserved unit/filter symbols.
review.sharedSources: Equipment implementation and display helper bytes identical across products.

surfaces.runtimeLimit: Existing equipment locale fixtures and profile-default tests supplement source review; not every import/save error or native-speaker accuracy exercised.

surfaces.boundary: Qt fallback chooser labels, actions, file model headers, menus, errors and selected-locale size/date; external MIME associations remain provider data.
surfaces.auditState: current source correspondence reviewed; no missing owned caption identified in inventoried Qt versions and app chooser paths

review.contexts: Exact Qt line edit/text/spin contexts, chooser/file-model/icon-provider contexts and standard-button contexts; no blanket plugin-context substitution.
review.upstreamInventory: Qt6.4/6.12 reviewed captions mapped; Alt key bindings preserved, Show fragment replaced by guarded whole header actions.
review.chooserWrappers: App titles/filter labels supplied through translated callers. Native/default picker if selected locale matches system; otherwise fallback picker with selected-locale proxy.
review.proxy: Only size/date DisplayRole changes; filenames, paths, edit roles, source identity and operations delegate unchanged.
review.sourceMatch: These production files match the already qualified current-app Windows head; Linux package evidence retained separately.

surfaces.runtimeLimit: Compiled tests and installed locale fixtures cover actual captions, modal selection/cancellation, selected errors and accessibility names. Native OS interactions, screen-reader speech and protected-path failures remain separate unexercised scopes; external MIME descriptions are preserved.

surfaces.boundary: Update reminders/status, startup controls/errors and per-user registration; stable names/commands/versions preserved.
surfaces.auditState: current source correspondence reviewed; no missing owned string identified
surfaces.review: Update panel constructors/buttons/help and all status branches use SC_TR. remind(message) producers are translated local-download, changed-binary and published-update templates. Inserted version/file paths remain opaque. Startup panel title/toggle/help/warning use SC_TR; startup registration emits identities and platform commands only. Shared sources byte-identical across projects.
surfaces.runtimeLimit: Source correspondence review complements installed language fixtures; does not simulate every network response or actual user-login startup.

surfaces.boundary: Startup logging, exclusive-processing failures and calibration worker text transport.
surfaces.auditState: current source correspondence reviewed; process-conflict gap fixed; fresh installed qualification pending

review.startup: Four owned production qCritical failures use SC_TR UTF-8 strings. Startup paths/socket/process IDs remain invariant; QLocalServer error detail remains external.
review.guard: Acquisition/inspection/route-conflict diagnostics use SC_TR; both process-name conflict returns corrected to one translated template. Warning title/button localized; monitor forwards reason without reinterpretation.
calibrationStderr: Playing a logarithmic sweep from 20 Hz to 25 kHz
review.workerTransport: Complete translated UTF-8 lines/tails decoded with bounded64KiB buffer; failure recognition matches localized template around placeholder, not English prefix.
review.parent: Start/stop/incomplete/suggestion/keep/apply captions translated. Worker-reported failures retained; numerical JSON, capture data and waveform processing unchanged.
review.external: Recorder/PipeWire process error details preserved in translated owned wrapper. Raw fixture exceptions and qFatal assertions belong to explicit self-test/developer paths.
